name: USBee
description:
Glanceable USB and USB-C capability + charging info, powered by usbeehive.

Mounts a Quick Settings tile next to Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and Sound. Shows live charging wattage and link speed in the subtitle, expands to a popover listing every attached USB device and USB-C port with a plain-English diagnostic per port. Reads only from the usbeehive D-Bus daemon (org.usbeehive.Devices1); no /sys access, no subprocesses, no bundled binaries.

Requires the usbeehive daemon (systemctl --user enable --now usbeehive).
